verdict.rationale: Jeeves ships an API covering cards, payments, transactions, and expense data plus an MCP server enabling agents to check spend, pay vendors, manage cards, and submit reimbursements — significant UI parity for core financial actions. However, no evidence covers API parity for account setup, yield/Jeeves Cash management, team/role administration, invoice automation, or Boleto/global-account features fully mirrored via API, and OpenAPI/llms.txt discovery endpoints returned 404s, undermining self-describability. Missing for 10: comprehensive API coverage confirmation across all UI features (team management, yield accounts, invoice automation), working OpenAPI/llms.txt spec discovery, and independent verification of full UI-API parity.
